 Game Preview: Warriors at Memphis Grizzlies - 11/19/26
 Kalyb Champion Writer & Digital Content Coordinator November 18, 2026 11:33 AM PST WARRIORS FACE GRIZZLIES ON BACK-TO-BACK 
The Warriors head to Memphis to face the Grizzlies on the second night of a back-to-back at FedExForum on Thursday. Memphis is also on the second night of a back-to-back, facing the Cleveland Cavaliers on Wednesday. The Dubs are 0-1 against the Grizzlies, losing a double-digit lead in the final minutes at Chase Center on Oct. 23.  
 Tap To Watch
 Golden State Warriors 
 Shop INJURY & ROSTER NOTES 
 GSW: LJ Cryer (Left Low Back Soreness) is questionable. Draymond Green (Right Elbow Inflammation / Soreness), Stephen Curry (Right Oblique Tear), Jimmy Butler III (Right ACL Repair / Surgery), Moses Moody (Left Patellar Tendon Repair / Surgery), Brandon Williams (Left Hamstring Strain) and Kristaps Porzingis (Not With Team) are OUT. Team Notes 
 MEM: Isaiah Stewart (Illness) is questionable. Ty Jerome (Right Hip Impingement), Zach Edey (Left Ankle Injury Management), GG Jackson (Left 5th Metatarsal Fracture), Scotty Pippen Jr. (Lumbar Disc Herniation) and Richie Saunders (Right Knee Surgery) are OUT. Team Notes 
 Check out the Betway Insider for NBA news, picks and opinions across the 2026-27 season.  
 COMPELLING NOTE: 
 Warriors:  Yaxel Lendeborg has the second-most points by a rookie this season (291) and is one of two rookies averaging at least 20 points per game (20.8 PPG). Lendeborg was first on NBA.com’s latest Rookie of the Year Ladder . 
 Grizzlies:  Cameron Boozer was second on NBA.com’s latest Rookie of the Year ladder, scoring a career-high 29 points with seven 3-pointers on Monday. Boozer’s performance helped the Grizzlies extend their winning streak to three and become the fifth team in the Western Conference to reach double-digit wins.
